exploit_insights.rationale: Voluntarily enters fewer pots than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Overfolds to three-bets
exploit_insights.adjustment: Add blocker-driven three-bet bluffs while preserving the solver value core.
exploit_insights.rationale: Folds to three-bets above the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Wide three-betting
exploit_insights.adjustment: Defend opens more carefully with blockers and strengthen four-bet/value continuations.
exploit_insights.rationale: Three-bets more available opportunities than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: High flop c-bet rate
exploit_insights.adjustment: Defend more of the range that has backdoors and choose blocker-aware check-raises.
exploit_insights.rationale: Continuation-bets more flops than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Loose entry range
exploit_insights.adjustment: Isolate and value-bet a little wider; avoid assuming every continuation is strong.
exploit_insights.rationale: Voluntarily enters more pots than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: High postflop aggression
exploit_insights.adjustment: Protect checking ranges and bluff-catch slightly wider where blockers support it.
exploit_insights.rationale: Chooses aggressive postflop actions above the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Showdown-bound
exploit_insights.adjustment: Value-bet thinner and trim low-equity river bluffs.
exploit_insights.rationale: Reaches showdown above the reference band after seeing a flop.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Overfolds to three-bets
exploit_insights.adjustment: Add blocker-driven three-bet bluffs while preserving the solver value core.
exploit_insights.rationale: Folds to three-bets above the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: High flop c-bet rate
exploit_insights.adjustment: Defend more of the range that has backdoors and choose blocker-aware check-raises.
exploit_insights.rationale: Continuation-bets more flops than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Overfolds to flop c-bets
exploit_insights.adjustment: Expand small c-bet bluffs on favorable boards and preserve turn follow-through candidates.
exploit_insights.rationale: Folds to flop c-bets above the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.

exploit_insights.title: Narrow three-betting
exploit_insights.adjustment: Fold marginal opens more readily to three-bets and reduce light four-bets.
exploit_insights.rationale: Three-bets fewer available opportunities than the reference band.
exploit_insights.baseline_note: Directional exploit overlay; solver strategy remains the default baseline.
